format: Each case feeds 'packets' (RTP packets as hex, one UDP datagram each, in this order) to a fresh depacketizer. It must output exactly 'nals', in order: each NAL unit as hex without a start code, with the RTP timestamp of its packets and 'au_end' true when the packet that completed it carried the marker bit (the end of an access unit).

'counters' are the depacketizer's drop counters after the case: stap_a_dropped counts STAP-A packets; fu_a_dropped counts FU-A packets that end up in no output NAL; unsupported_dropped counts packets of payload types 0, 25, 26, 27, 29, 30 and 31; invalid_dropped counts packets that are not valid RTP.
Payload type 96, SSRC 1234abcd, 90 kHz timestamps, 1200 bytes of payload per packet at most.

cases.name: single_nal_units
cases.text: Parameter sets, SEI and slices that fit one packet each.

cases.name: fu_a
cases.text: A 2600-byte IDR in three FU-A fragments and a 1500-byte slice in two.

cases.name: stap_a_dropped
cases.text: STAP-A is dropped and counted; the following IDR still comes out.

packets.note: STAP-A with SPS and PPS: dropped

cases.name: fu_a_gap
cases.text: A lost middle fragment drops the whole NAL (start and end fragments).

cases.name: fu_a_without_start
cases.text: Fragments that arrive without their start are dropped.

cases.name: fu_a_timestamp_change
cases.text: A timestamp change inside a fragmented NAL drops it.

packets.note: timestamp changed before the end fragment

cases.name: fu_a_interrupted
cases.text: Another packet inside a fragmented NAL drops the unfinished NAL and the fragments after it; the other packet's NAL comes out.

packets.note: a single NAL before the end fragment

cases.name: sequence_wrap
cases.text: Sequence numbers 65533 to 65535 and on to 1 are contiguous; the FU-A across the wrap is joined.

cases.name: header_variants
cases.text: CSRCs, a header extension and padding are skipped.

cases.name: dropped_packets
cases.text: Invalid RTP packets and unsupported payload types produce nothing.

packets.note: 8 bytes: shorter than an RTP header
padding count 20 exceeds the 4 payload bytes: invalid
